statement: The 999 normal entrypoint carries the same product requirements as the primary flavour and reaches them through its own adapters. Where this tree has no carrier for a requirement, the requirement is declared absent with the unit that owes it and the upgrade path; it is never simulated, and a declaration that stops matching the tree fails the check.

observed_n999_head.method: read-only shallow clone, git cat-file and direct execution at .claude/skills/drama-song-ad-factory; no write, no install, no credential

absent.scripts/openclaw_adapter.py: this is the primary flavour's runtime wrapper; the 999 normal entrypoint is its own adapters/ tree

command_delta_vs_primary.observed_at_999_head: python3 scripts/core/intake_preflight/factory.py <cmd> --help exits 2 (argparse: invalid choice) for both names, so neither is advertised by this package
command_delta_vs_primary.rule: advertised commands must be a subset of the subcommands the operating factory.py actually implements

assembled_from.rule: The seam and its data are consumed as delivered by S75-T03 and are not re-derived here. package/999_adapter.py calls package_flavor_adapter.resolve('999') and refuses when the values below disagree with it.

product_requirements.means: A stage whose required artifacts are absent is refused, and the refusal names every required artifact that is missing.
An empty cast fails closed; a one-line placeholder scene fails closed on dialogue and duration.

absent.missing_capability: text-first identity saves without an image and a later image attachment does not duplicate the identity
absent.upgrade_path: Land S75-T15's notion_store.py under scripts/core/character_library/; this row then flips to carried and its carrier is probed.

absent.missing_capability: idempotent local-library migration with dry run and rollback
absent.upgrade_path: Land S75-T17's migration.py; this row then flips to carried and its carrier is probed.

product_requirements.means: Discovery and the sync protocol ship in this tree; the store and the migration module do not, and the row says so instead of reporting Notion met.
Eighteen unique style ids resolve one-to-one, and the original three keep their order and their descriptions.
Music is refused without a package approval and refused again when that approval's bound digests have moved; a current binding admits it.
Both flavours resolve against byte-identical shared core and differ in exactly the two declared package facts, so the 999 package reaches the same behaviour without forking it.

absent.missing_capability: legacy paid artifacts remain readable and compatibility-limited without automatic regeneration
absent.upgrade_path: Land S75-T28's compatibility.py plus its legacy map; this row then flips to carried and its carrier is probed.

product_requirements.means: No 999 carrier exists at this head for paid-artifact compatibility. The requirement is reported unmet with its owner, never reported met.

own_adapters.rule: The 999 normal entrypoint is this package's own adapter plus the 999 adapters/ tree. It never routes through the primary flavour's package adapter or its runtime wrapper.

layout_source.detected_by: skill root basename is 75-drama-song-ad-factory (the primary flavour's physical tree, where S75 source ships before the 999 landing)
layout_source.meaning: The primary front door exists here; the 999 package must not call it.

entrypoints.rule: Every advertised step carries a complete argv and an observed exit code. A step that cannot execute at this head sits in fixture.excluded_steps with its observed failure; it is never advertised as runnable.

unverified: install into a live 999 box was not performed; no box, client or credential was touched.
The 999 tree observed at batch/s75-story-first does not yet carry the S75-T15/T16/T17/T28 modules, so the notion and paid-compatibility rows are declared partial/absent rather than met.
